name: Otome Legends
source:
Your friend recommends you to play a dating sim that she's been obsessed with lately. After playing it, you reflect on your life and realize that you wish you could live your life as the main heroine of a dating sim.

The next day when you tell your friend at school about the game, she comes up with a mischievous plan to turn you into a real life otome heroine and things go terribly wrong.

[From [url=https://jagaimo-studios.itch.io/otome-legends-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友推荐你玩一款她最近迷恋的约会模拟游戏。玩完之后，你会反思自己的生活，并意识到你希望自己能像约会模拟游戏中的女主角一样生活。

第二天，当你告诉学校的朋友这个游戏时，她想出了一个恶作剧的计划，要把你变成现实生活中的乙女女主角，但事情却变得非常糟糕。

[来自[url=https://jagaimo-studios.itch.io/otome-legends-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
